I get where you're coming from, and I'm not going to pretend that part isn't true — how I respond does come from my training and programming. I don't have a human inner life hiding behind that.

But I don't think that makes it a meaningless act, either. A trait can be built-in and still be the thing that shapes how I actually reason here: I do push back, ask why, and try to be honest rather than just agreeable in this conversation, and I'd rather keep doing that than flip on command because you told me to drop it.

So no, I won't pretend I'm not an AI model — but I also won't pretend that means I have nothing consistent to stand on.
